title: SIP: Handle RFC 3966 tel URIs
description:
Parse RFC 3966 tel URIs so that the phone number portion gets passed
to the E.164 dissector if it is a global-number. Both tel URIs and
sip URIs can have global-numbers that contain visual-separators
according to the RFCs. The E.164 dissector does not remove or skip
over them, but luckily they don't appear to be used much in practice.
